source: make Quick Actions play once and align Claims table with Compass

assumptions.text: Each Quick Action GIF has 13 frames over 520 milliseconds, so one hover plays for 520 milliseconds and then holds its extracted final frame
Leaving a Quick Action resets it to the extracted first frame so the next hover can play once again
Recent Claims uses the complete Compass Table anatomy with TableCaption, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, and TableCell
Compass Table defaults control header casing, header background, row density, borders, and hover states without screen-specific overrides
Claim statuses use Compass Badge, row actions use Button, and paging uses Pagination
Claims filters use InputGroup, Popover with Calendar, and Select; reports use DropdownMenu; metrics and recent claims use Card
The Claims metrics note uses the default Compass Alert surface instead of removing its border, background, and padding
Semantic layout elements, Next Image assets, and date formatting remain outside Compass only where no matching design-system primitive exists
